Amazing food!
Sep 2017 • Couples
Visited late evening and found it to be so busy, always a good sign in this little eateries! We decided to stay in line and wait for a table to become available. We looked at the menu before sitting so not to waste any time, good customers we are. The staff told us about how they cook everything fresh to order in a tiny kitchen so we were shocked and quite happy to see nothing wasted or being sat around in the kitchen for too long.
The food was delicious, we ordered a variety of items, Pho, Bulgogi and coconut rice along with some snack starters and we couldn't be happier with the meal. Very good value for money and generous portions. Everything was seasoned well and tasted delicious!

Cold Chicken
Sep 2017
This is the first time ever that I was served cold chicken. But that wasn't the epiphany of failures. I've had broken rice many times before and I'm pretty sure that wasn't broken rice. Rice was clumpy, pork chop was actually short ribs (frozen pre-made), and other elements of what makes a broken rice was missing. 

To top it off, there was the other two patrons that ordered fish, but was served tofu, and ordered ice cream, but was given yogurt. I mean how can you seriously not know those aren't exactly the same thing? 

I would assume, this shop was actually owned and built on the original "mum" that was cooking behind the stoves previously. Looks like "she" is gone, so there isn't any point trying this place out anymore.
